d.why: On screen in Jessica Jones S3 episodes 9 and 11 (AKA I Did Something Today, AKA Hero Pants); only a photo or mentions after that.

Only in AKA Sorry Face (JJ S3E6), where the chef tells Jessica how Sallinger taped him to a chair and gives her a lead; he is a witness in Jessica's hunt, and has no family or boss tie to anyone with a file.

Only in the cold open of AKA The Perfect Burger (JJ S3E1), as the Amber Alert runaway Jessica brings back from Mexico; that episode is about Dorothy asking for help finding Trish, and Cassie's parents have no files.
On screen in three Jessica Jones S3 episodes (AKA I Did Something Today, AKA Hellcat, AKA Hero Pants) as a detective on the Nussbaumer case.
Only in AKA Customer Service is Standing By (JJ S3E4), as the muscle who drops Erik in the pool, but he is the son of Sal Blaskowski, who has a file.
On screen in two Jessica Jones S3 episodes, AKA I Wish and AKA Sorry Face, as Brianna's pimp.
On screen in six Jessica Jones S3 episodes as Trish's co-host on ARN.
On screen in Jessica Jones S3 episodes 9 to 12 as the detective leading the Nussbaumer case.
On screen in Jessica Jones S3 episodes 10 and 11 (AKA Hellcat, AKA Hero Pants, which shows the same night).
On screen in Jessica Jones S3 episodes 6 and 9 (AKA Sorry Face, AKA I Did Something Today); he is also the son of Kith Lyonne, who has a file.

Only in AKA The Double Half-Wappinger (JJ S3E7), where he tells Jessica about his son Nathan and Sallinger and backs her search; he is a relative in Jessica's story, but he is kept as the husband of Ana Silva, who has a file.
On screen in Jessica Jones S3 episodes 1, 3 and 5 as Kith's husband, who steals from the scholarship fund and kills himself.
Only in AKA You're Welcome (JJ S3E2) and mentioned later; he is the target of that episode's main thread, the rapist Trish stakes out and beats in her first act as a vigilante.
Only in AKA Customer Service is Standing By (JJ S3E4); that episode is about Jessica and Erik tracking down his three blackmail marks, and she is one of them, the embezzler Jessica exposes.

Only in AKA The Double Half-Wappinger (JJ S3E7), as the local deputy who refuses Jessica the Sallinger file and draws a gun while Jessica digs; she gets in the way but does not decide the episode, and has no family or boss tie to anyone with a file.

Only in AKA Customer Service is Standing By (JJ S3E4) and mentioned later; she is the bookie drowning Erik, the villain of the episode's climax where masked Trish saves him, and she is also the mother and boss of Dwayne, who has a file.
Only in AKA Customer Service is Standing By (JJ S3E4); that episode is about Erik's three blackmail marks, and he is mark number one, the predator Jessica exposes and locks up for the police.
On screen in nine Jessica Jones S3 episodes as a lawyer at Jeri's firm and Malcolm's girlfriend.
On screen in Loki S2 episodes 1, 4 and 6 as a TVA judge.

Only in the Seagate flashbacks of Step in the Arena (LC S1E4) and mentioned later; he is that episode's main villain, the guard who runs the fight club and sabotages Burstein's experiment, and he is also the boss of Shades, who has a file.
On screen in Luke Cage S1 episodes 1 to 3.
On screen in Luke Cage S1 episodes 7, 10 and 11 as Mariah's council rival.
Only in the flashbacks of Take It Personal (LC S1E10), where she argues with Etta, but she is the mother of Diamondback and the lover of James Lucas, who both have files.

Only alive in Moment of Truth (LC S1E1), with a corpse in crime-scene photos and a photo after that; he is the inside man who sets up the junkyard robbery the episode is about, and his dying call to Tone, naming the robbers, sets off what happens next.

Only in Take It Personal (LC S1E10), where the detective beats Lonnie Wilson in custody and is suspended; he is a cop with a few lines in the hunt for Luke, and Ridley is his boss, not the other way round.
On screen in Luke Cage S1 episodes 10, 12 and 13 (Take It Personal, Soliloquy of Chaos, You Know My Steez).
On screen in Luke Cage S1 episodes 1 and 5 (Moment of Truth, Just to Get a Rep).
On screen in Luke Cage S1 episodes 11 to 13 (Now You're Mine, Soliloquy of Chaos, You Know My Steez) as the ESU lieutenant.
On screen in Luke Cage S1 episodes 1, 3, 7 and 9 as a news reporter.
On screen in Luke Cage S1 episodes 4 (flashbacks), 9, 10 and 13 as the Seagate doctor who made Luke.
